We appreciate the feedback. Thank you for reviewing our new Timberline, David.
We sent all the firmware updates out 2 weeks ago to ensure our new grills received them and are now functioning properly.
Please do not hesitate to give us a call at 1-800-TRAEGER, if you're still having temperature issues, or if you did not receive this firmware update so we can get it manually pushed out to your Traeger, and get you cooking as expected. We're here 7 days a week, and always happy to help.

Results.ReviewText: I purchased the new Timberline to replace an existing Traeger that I use 3-4 times a week on average. On initial startup and seasoning the grill never achieved the target temperature. I made sure all of the latest firmware updates were applied. I then tried a high-temp cook at 500 degrees… after 45 minutes it never got above 225. Called customer support. They were very nice, but said this is a known issue that they’re working on. Couldn’t give me an estimated date for a solution. Searching reviews here and on other websites, this appears to be a significant problem with these new Timberlines. I wanted to love this grill… it offers so many improvements over my older model. Unfortunately, it’s currently a very expensive lawn ornament. Traeger, please fix this and make it right.
Results.Title: New Timberline has temperature control problems

ClientResponses.Response:
Victor, thank you so much for reviewing our New Timberline. 
We sent out another firmware update 2 weeks ago that should have resolved these types of temperature issues. If your grill did not receive the latest update patch, and/or if you're still experiencing temperature swings greater than the allowed window of 15 degrees off (+/-) your set temperature, please reach out to us any day of the week, and we'd be more than happy to assist with getting your Traeger up and functioning properly. 
We cover our new Timberline Series grills with a 10-year warranty, and we honor that warranty by keeping your grill up and functioning as expected.

Results.ReviewText:
Super excited to get my first Treager. Been using a competitors brand for years.  Right out of the box, the controller screen has a chip/crack in it. And then, seasoning never did achieve 500 degrees. 
Fired up the grill this morning,(day 2) and the grill took 42 minutes to reach 500 degrees and then over shot to 513. Then dropped to 490, then up to 523.  I did all the firmware updates right after unboxing. 

Very disappointed with the temp control!! If this is how it’s supposed to be, it’s garbage! 42 minutes to get to 500 degrees is not innovative or ground breaking, it’s horribly long and it took so long because every few degrees, the temp dropped considerably.

In addition, this grill doesn’t have a temp setting as high. It has 500 degrees. So 500 should not be 523!
Results.Title: Not happy day one

Results.ReviewText: So after outgrowing my ironwood 650 and timberline 1300,I splurged on the XL and oh my was it the right choice. My ironwood is at a buddies house where the allowed him to put it on a balcony and my timberline 1300 is at my other buddies house, my XL is flanked by my Weber Summit and my Pitboss Ultimate 5 griddle. I have the ultimate patio for cooking

The tech support team continues to impress me with their top notch service and attentiveness to the needs of its customers.  Great work Traeger!

Results.ReviewText:
Having owned and cooked on several traeger grills in the past, I was excited to see traeger innovating with this new grill. I purchased this yesterday, got it all setup and went through the onboarding. Want to share my experience as “most” of the the other reviews online are from influencers. Having spent my own money on this I will give an honest review.

First, the good; this thing is a tank and was so well thought out on the build process. It looks absolutely beautiful and the tech in this grill is beyond anything out there with pellet grills.

Now the negative: After setting up I seasoned the grill with the automated onboarding setup. Everything appeared to be working but I noticed it was set to 500 halfway through the seasoning and would not get above 370. Once it hit 370 it actually started cooling down til it 70 degrees by the time it finished seasoning. No errors at all as a matter of fact it said seasoning complete.

I called support and after three hours of troubleshooting and testing it would appear the grill won’t get anywhere near correct temp. I can set the temp to 400 and it will sit at 170 and actually tell me it has reached the temp on the grill and on the app. (Keep in mind it took 25 minutes to get to 170). Traeger support was escalating to beta team and tier 4 support and said they would call me back and give me update.

They called me back and said they are thinking it might be firmware and they will probably get back to me sometime next week. The lady from support also said she just got off the phone with someone else that was having the EXACT SAME ISSUE! So I knew I need to write a review.

Here is my problem and I will change the review if this gets fixed but traeger released this grill to influencers nearly a month ago. I waited til yesterday when I could buy and after a month of beta testing with influencers you are still selling a nearly $4000 grill that basically is just a lawn ornament at this time and rather than sending someone immediately to fix, their answer was hopefully sometime next week as it might be a software issue and they have to figure it out.

I am extremely disappointed. I was super excited to get this grill. After finding out support had back to back calls on the first day around here we were able to buy, this is a major ball drop from traeger. Until they fix this, I will leave this review up. I will edit if they actually follow through with my experience when I can actually cook on it.

****Buyer beware if you are looking at picking this up this weekend****
Results.Title: Does not get to temp out of the box

Results.ReviewText:
Long, but worth a read from someone who spent hard earned money for this smoker instead of receiving as a promotion*

To begin, I was a Traeger hater not because of social media but due to the fact that the Pro 22 I had 3 years ago wasn’t great. It was a basic entry pellet smoker and that was it; not a grill to sear or for use in the winter. From that point on, I went back to using other pellet grill brands and mostly charcoal grills such as a Kamado, a Bronco, and a MB 850. I had rid myself of the Traeger brand only committing to returning if they made something worth while with a better warranty. Low and behold, the year had arrived. 

I was a little skeptical at the beginning pre live stream “release” with even seeing a leaked box and price on reddit. I was a little offended by the price simply because I was a “hater” still and shrugged it off as stupid. The live stream happened and what everyone thought, I had believed as well: it was beyond beautiful but the tag was insane for a pellet grill. Two weeks went by & I kept going back to the new Traeger to look at it and understand that this is what I had personally wanted from Traeger: A larger warranty, no paint to peel from heat, and the ability to sear. The extras are a bonus such as better smoke flavor, and a new easy cleanup. 

So a week and a half before today’s (Apr 22) official launch that everyone could start buying, I purchased one which to me was a huge risk. Almost two weeks later I have to say it is living up to the hype. A little buggy from the get go (the automated seasoning pre programmed in the controller bugged out and stopped) but a massive improvement from previous models. I would say being well versed in grills or specifically pellet grills has helped with the new beta software, but she is a beaut. 

Smoke flavor is better than most if not all pellet grills on the market (still have not used super smoke-not needed much now) and I attribute this to the new delivery by the AI in the controller. From start up (literally from ignition) to shutdown you are receiving blue smoke constantly. It runs as smoothly as an offset in terms of constant delivery of wood flavor and smoke production (obviously taste is not the same considering scientifically pellets are just less moist for offset flavor). The induction works flawlessly and can produce excellent searing on your cast iron without overheating said cast iron and transferring cast iron flavor to your protein. 

I have to say I am impressed with the new Timberline XL and by the craftsmanship of the grill itself. Built to last is hard to relate to a reader but the paint is gone and replaced with an enamel type finish. The grill feels like its worth the money for once (sorry Traeger) and the 10 year warranty has at the very least quelled any fears for the future. In my opinion, this is Traeger's first “premium” grill. Not the timberline Gen 1. So as to whether it is worth it? Yes, absolutely. If you have the financial ability to do so, this grill does edge out most of the competition if not all of it. It’s a hard pill to swallow, but Traeger has finally earned my respect. I may not be a fan boy but this grill gives me the ability to defend the naysayers for once without being one myself any longer. Im more than happy with the product they rolled out and again, for once it looks like they have genuine care for a product of theirs in terms of build quality. Have a good one ya’ll. 

P.S. I still recommend purchasing a front shelf for extra space.
Results.Title: Pound for Pound

Results.ReviewText: I have had my new Timberline XL since last Saturday. I have cooked wings, drums, tri tip, season chicken thigh meat, sirloin steaks and grilled some garlic green beans. I can tell you hands down this is the BEST grill/smoker I have ever owned!! I got a definitive smoke ring on my tri tip and the flavor profiles have been off the hook. It is BIG and with all that space I find myself not needing shelves or tables to accompany my experience. Its been absolutely phenomenal. I am coming from a Silverton 620 to this so I am in HEAVEN! If you don't have one you need one!!!
Results.Title: Timberline XL is the ULTIMATE pellet grill!!!

Results.ReviewText: This smoker is so large it easily fits anything I want to cook, even when I've had guests over. The induction cooktop is very nice too as I can easily sear meets that I want to, post smoke, or cook up some tasty green beans to complement the main dish. It is the first time I've used an induction cooktop and was amazed at how quickly it heated, and how well it worked. The overall polish on this smoker is spot on too - the bamboo cooking board and shelves added a nice touch (however, if you live in a very humid area be sure to not let them sit in the rain as they'll mold up quickly. Mine did so I needed to give them a sanding and refinish (just cutting board oil).
Results.Title: Super nice smoker and space for a huge party meal

Photos.Caption: Seared Steaks on the Induction CookTop
Brisket Points Smoked on the Traeger XL

Results.ReviewText: She is a beauty but don't let that fool you.  She is built tank tough.  Perfect for outdoor cooking on the backyard.  Plenty of Grill Space - 1320 sq inches.  Great and EASY WIFIRE and Meater probe connectivity.   Easier clean up with combined ash and grease bucket.  AND THE INDUCTION COOKTOP IS AMAZING.  Already used it for Frying, Searing, and Sauteing.  AND THE SMOKE.  Have to mention all the SMOKE even up to 500 degrees.  I wrapped pork butts and briskets after all night super smoke and my fingers smelled of smoke.
Results.Title: BUILT LIKE A TANK BUT BEAUTIFUL & COOKS LIKE A PRO

Results.ReviewText: What a great looking grill! I’m sure with Traeger’s quality this grill will last, as do all of the grills they’ve produced over the years if you take care of it. Can’t wait to cook on it.
Results.Title: Awesome

Results.ReviewText: I received this grill as part of a Beta test for Traeger grills.  I have used it almost every day since then. The available grill space is amazing, the main grill area is more than adequate for any large gathering grill needs.  There are two upper racks as well, so you can grill/smoke your main entree, and cook your sides like vegetables at the same time.  The interior light is handy, but it would be nice to have one located on both sides of the grill and in the back. The temperature guide and ignition system are very easy to use.  Being able to monitor the grill temperature from my phone is also a great feature.  The side induction stovetop is convenient and provides an added cooking surface for sauces and sides. There is a lot of storage under the grill and the ash bucket is easily located and cleaned. The utensil rack, paper towel rack, and added shelves for storage make it easy to keep all your grilling supplies handy!
Results.Title: Great Features! Easy to Use

Results.ReviewText:
I've been using this for over 6 months. In all weather. It's an awesome grill, smoker and everything in between. The induction is a great addition to the grill. I can use it with a cast iron griddle to sear steaks to perfection while the sides are still in the Traeger smoking. The capacity is amazing - see attached pic of over 90 lbs. of beef chuck. Still plenty of space for smoke and airflow in between the pcs. 
Cleanup is very simple because of the grease and ash keg system.
Results.Title: All in one grill!

Photos.Caption: Prepping tomatoes for Roasted Tomato Pizza Sauce
BBQ Chicken, Smashed Garlic Potatoes , and Grilled Asparagus all done on the Traeger.

Results.ReviewText: I have had my Traeger for about 6 months now and have nothing but praise to share! Not only was I a novice at grilling and smoking, no one would have ever accused me of being a technology wiz. Given that background, I was initially nervous that this Traeger would be too complicated for me. Thankfully, I have continually been shocked about the ease of operation of the Traeger. The WiFire connection and interface was quick to install and made operating the grill and preparing recipes as though an expert was right by your side. From igniting the grill, monitoring and adjusting the temperature, accurate probes to ensure correct internal meat temperature, recipes, timers, and shutdown, the entire cooking process couldn’t be easier. I have cooked a variety of proteins in a variety of ways ranging from reverse seating to long smoking, each with great success. The induction cooktop is an added bonus. I have noticed, however, that the cook time is longer on the Traeger induction burner than my kitchen induction stovetop. I attribute this to the cold outdoor temperatures during the winter months and am anxious to compare once the summer arrives. There is plenty of storage for accessories beneath the grill. The wooden cutting board that magnetically attaches to the pellet hopper did become “moldy” this winter and I ultimately took it off. Once again, I attribute that to the fact that I live in Washington State where it rains much of the winter. Others in a dryer climate may not experience this issue. Overall, I am thrilled with the new Traeger and look forward to many years of fun entertaining!
Results.Title: From Novice to Pit Boss!!

Results.ReviewText: The first smoke I did on the grill was St. Louis style ribs. They turned out great.  I really liked the light in the grill, great feature.
Results.Title: Perfect smoke

Results.ReviewText: From extra large surface area, induction stove top, easy to clean grease and ash trap, storage area and shelves, insulated cover, easy to empty pellet bin, this smoker has so many things I didn't know I needed in a smoker, but I find that I use every single feature. The ease of use means I am using it much more often than my previous smoker. It has almost made my kitchen obsolete.
Results.Title: Everything I didn't know I needed

Results.ReviewText: This Traeger is the best.  Lots of cool features, even many I never imagined.  Like the pellet drain system when you want to change flavors.  Or the multiple probes so we don’t have to guess  when pulling each person’s steak.
Results.Title: Love this Traeger!

Results.ReviewText: Amazing design and display. Smokes great and easy cleanup.
